annotation.title_clean: 特定自動運行許可に係る申請書等の記載要領
annotation.title_en: Guidelines for Completing Applications etc. for Specified Automated Operation Permits
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 警察庁交通局 (National Police Agency, Traffic Bureau)
named_instruments_referenced: Japan Road Traffic Act (specified automated operation permit)
annotation.summary_en: Japan National Police Agency's March 2026 guidance on completing applications for specified automated operation (Level 4 driverless vehicle) permits under the Road Traffic Act. It sets required plan contents, remote monitoring requirements, personnel training, accident and stoppage response, and the points prefectural public safety commissions examine.
key_provisions_or_claims: Applications go to the prefectural public safety commission with the operation plan covering route, hours, weather, road conditions and traffic impact.
Remote monitoring equipment must provide continuous video, audio, location, communication alerts, recording and cybersecurity measures.
Specified automated operation chief officers and on-site response staff must be trained, designated and meet qualification requirements.
Plans must set procedures for ending operation, accidents, railway crossings and main carriageway stoppages.
Vehicles must display an 'automated driving' indicator linked to system status; disqualification applies after permit revocation within five years.
